candidates.change_summary: Change return value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to bytes4(0x00000000)
Change return value from ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector to a different valid ERC721TokenReceiver selector like bytes4(0x150b7a03) (a different selector)
Replace assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = address(0);' to cause baseToken to always be zero after initialize.
Replace assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = _nft;' to set baseToken equal to the NFT address instead of the base token parameter.
Delete the assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' so baseToken retains its default zero value (or previous value in proxy scenarios) after initialize.
Replace assignment 'baseToken = _baseToken;' with 'baseToken = address(this);' causing baseToken to be the pool's own address.
Remove the assignment of the nft state variable so it retains its default zero address.
Assign nft = _baseToken instead of nft = _nft so the state variable refers to the base token.
Assign nft = address(this) instead of nft = _nft so the state variable points to the pool itself.
Change the assignment of changeFee from the parameter _changeFee to a constant value (e.g., 0) so that after initialize completes, changeFee differs.
Delete the assignment that sets changeFee so that it retains its default value (0) instead of taking the parameter value.
Change the right-hand side of the changeFee assignment to always add 1 to _changeFee, making the stored value differ.
Replace feeRate assignment with a constant value, e.g. 500.
Delete the feeRate assignment statement, leaving feeRate at its default zero value.
Replace feeRate assignment with assignment from changeFee cast to uint16.
Move feeRate assignment after initialized = true, causing feeRate to remain unchanged if reinitialization guard triggers.
Delete the assignment `initialized = true;` so the flag never gets set.
Move `initialized = true;` before the check `if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();` so the guard always reverts and the flag remains false for any successful call.
